question: What deficiencies disqualify a person in the context of devotion?
premises: A person may be devoid of devotion to the kula.
A person may be deprived of devotion to the guru.
inference: Lack of devotion to both kula and guru marks a disqualified person.
plain_english: Indeed, in one devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
